name: Opulent Web Eater
summary: The Opulent Web Eater is one of the mysterious so-called "Opulent" of the Night Market who control the Gilded, Argent and Brazen below them and is associated with the Skittering Precinct as its ruler. He can be found with the Knightshade and Arid Varlet in the Opulent Ordeal trial. It takes the form of a humanoid Hunger. In comparison to the other Opulent, very little is known about him, other than he wants to eat people.
